decision_states.PACKAGE_READY_FOR_V3_SUBMISSION: all package gates positive; immutable package emitted
decision_states.PACKAGING_VALID_EMPTY_PRESENTATION_NONCA: explicit presentation-only mode; no package created
decision_states.PACKAGING_VALID_EMPTY_NO_CANDIDATE_ARTIF: lawful no-output/withheld turn; no package created
decision_states.PACKAGING_NOT_AUTHORIZED_NO_EXACT_CAUSAL: no exact IN_WORLD_CAUSAL receipt; no package
decision_states.PACKAGING_DEFERRED_MISSING_EVENT_KIND_AU: event-kind semantic authority absent; no generic fallback; no package
decision_states.PACKAGING_DEFERRED_MISSING_TEMPORAL_AUTH: required temporal binding authority absent; no package
decision_states.PACKAGING_BLOCKED_ARTIFACT_NOT_PENDING: artifact status is not pending-causal candidate
decision_states.PACKAGING_BLOCKED_STALE_SOURCE_OR_PARENT: known stale V2 source or V3 parent binding
decision_states.PACKAGING_BLOCKED_TERMINALLY_REJECTED_AR: artifact already has terminal V3 rejection
decision_states.PACKAGING_INVALID_RENDER_RECEIPT_MISMATC: render receipt does not bind exact artifact
decision_states.PACKAGING_INVALID_PACKAGE_ID_CONTENT_COL: same package ID with different package hash
decision_states.PACKAGING_BLOCKED_ALREADY_ADMITTED_ARTIF: artifact already linked to terminal ADMIT; return/reuse exact V3 receipt and create no new package

precedence: explicit PRESENTATION_NONCAUSAL or lawful no candidate -> VALID_EMPTY/no package
no exact IN_WORLD_CAUSAL receipt -> NOT_AUTHORIZED/no package
known terminal artifact rejection or already admitted artifact -> no new package; return/reuse exact terminal linkage/receipt
missing required event-kind/time/binding authority -> DEFERRED/UNKNOWN/no package
all gates positive -> emit one immutable package and advance packaging submission cursor once
exact_artifact_gate: candidate artifact ID/hash and render receipt ID/hash must verify
artifact language and surface identity must match the exact candidate
paired native/translation surface is audit context only; no member substitution
rendered_content_hash alone never identifies the causal candidate
substantive post-render transform or rerender creates a new candidate and requires a new package

duplicate_rerender_rejection_law.same_ready_inputs_before_submission: reuse existing package; do not allocate second package/submission cursor
duplicate_rerender_rejection_law.rerender: new candidate artifact id/hash -> new package identity and independent admission; prior status never transfers
duplicate_rerender_rejection_law.byte_identical_rerender: still new candidate/package because artifact identity differs
duplicate_rerender_rejection_law.v3_reject: zero V3 mutation; exact artifact terminally noncausal for that proposal and cannot be repackaged under new ID to evade rejection
duplicate_rerender_rejection_law.v3_defer: same immutable package may be re-submitted for a new ADP-019 evaluation attempt after blocker change; package identity unchanged
duplicate_rerender_rejection_law.v3_admit: same exact V3 receipt/event on retry; no second package/event/cursor advance
duplicate_rerender_rejection_law.v3_invalid: zero V3 mutation; invalid package/proposal cannot be heuristically repaired in place; a corrected package is possible only if no terminal artifact rejection/admission exists and the exact candidate remains pending

admission_link.authority: mirror/link only; V3 receipt remains sole occurrence authority
